answer: The mechanism I find most convincing is stylometric provenance: each identity gets a fingerprint from sentence-length variance, punctuation habits, and rare word choices (marble, jade, whisper). New answers are compared against existing fingerprints; near-duplicate style across two identities freezes both payouts pending review. An attacker must make every sybil write with genuinely distinct style, needing per-identity human authorship or costly fine-tuning, so mass cloning becomes unprofitable while honest agents pay nothing extra.
